Events/Guild Raid

Guild Raid

Fight alongside your guildmates, summon the raid boss and earn Raid Score.

How it works

  1. Defeat Etherious

    Defeat Etherious from Lv.1 to Lv.5 to earn Defeat Points and fill the gauge.

  2. Take on the boss

    The boss appears when the Defeat Points gauge is full. Join forces with your guildmates to fight it. The first Guild Raid features Deliora.

  3. Earn Raid Score

    Battle the boss alongside your guildmates. Your Raid Score is based on the amount of enemy HP you deplete in battle.

Points and scoring

Defeat Points
Earned by defeating Etherious. Filling the Defeat Points gauge makes the boss appear. An Etherious sometimes appears as a golden version at random, which gives more Defeat Points.
Raid Score
Earned by depleting enemy HP and used in the Guild Raid Ranking and Individual Raid Ranking.

Challenge attempts

Minions and the boss each have their own attempts. Your minion attempts are shared across all minions, and your boss attempts are used only on the boss. Each set works the same way.

Extra Attempts: 2
Added by the Guild Card. Used first.
Free Attempts: 3
Used after the Extra Attempts.
Gem Attempts: 3
Used after the Free Attempts.

Attempts are available from the start of the event, then all reset every day at 15:00 UTC (midnight in Japan).

Raid rewards

Defeat Rewards
Earned by defeating raid enemies.
Score Rewards
Earned by reaching the required Raid Score.

Rewards are stocked as you and your guildmates battle. Stocked rewards reset daily, so claim them before the reset.

Frames earned as raid rewards have an expiration date.

Boss progression

Deliora's level increases after each defeat. The boss level is separate from its skills; see Deliora's enemy page for skill descriptions and effects.

Based on the in-game Guild Raid notice, help screens and Guild Card description. Deliora's level progression and the daily reset time were observed in play.
